title: ControlTac: Scaling Tactile Data with Physically Controlled Tactile Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2505.20498v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-based tactile sensing is widely used in perception, reconstruction, and robotic manipulation, yet collecting large-scale tactile data remains costly due to diverse sensor-object interactions and inconsistencies across sensor instances. Existing approaches to scaling tactile data---simulation and free-form tactile generation---often yield unrealistically rendered signals with poor transfer to highly dynamic real-world tasks. We propose \name, a two-stage controllable tactile image generation framework that generates realistic tactile images conditioned on a single reference tactile image, contact force, and contact pose. By grounding generation in these important physical priors, \name synthesizes realistic samples across different sensors while effectively capturing task-relevant variations. translated_title: ControlTac：通过物理可控的触觉图像生成扩展触觉数据规模
translated_abstract: 基于视觉的触觉传感被广泛应用于感知、重建和机器人操作中，然而由于传感器与物体交互的多样性以及不同传感器实例之间的不一致性，收集大规模触觉数据仍然成本高昂。现有的触觉数据扩展方法——仿真和自由形式的触觉生成——通常会产生不真实的渲染信号，难以迁移到高度动态的真实世界任务中。我们提出ControlTac，一个两阶段可控触觉图像生成框架，它以单个参考触觉图像、接触力和接触位姿为条件生成逼真的触觉图像。通过将生成过程建立在这些重要的物理先验之上，ControlTac能够在不同传感器之间合成逼真的样本，同时有效捕捉与任务相关的变化。在一系列下游任务和真实世界实验中，例如物体插入、模仿学习和物体重称量任务中，
tldr: ControlTac提出了一种两阶段可控触觉图像生成框架，以单个参考触觉图像、接触力和接触位姿作为物理先验条件来生成逼真的触觉图像，从而实现跨传感器的触觉数据低成本扩展，并有效提升真实世界下游任务的表现。
en_tdlr: ControlTac is a two-stage controllable tactile image generation framework that generates realistic tactile images conditioned on physical priors (a single reference tactile image, contact force, and contact pose), enabling cost-effective scaling of tactile data across different sensors for real-world downstream tasks.
